<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/authentication/form"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Generates a redirect link to the hosted authentication form<br/><br/>If `expectedEmail` is set and the user completes the form as a different identity, the setup is rejected before any credentials are stored. The user stays on EmailEngine, which names both addresses and offers to restart the setup, so the browser is never redirected to `redirectUrl`.

  as={"h2"}
